tbesh_html:
1) perpetual, constant, perennial, ever-flowing
1a) ever-flowing (of a stream)
1b) permanence, permanent, enduring (fig.)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) אֵתָן ; from an unused root (meaning to continue);
